component.name: Order It Up
component.summary: Commercial offline-first POS & billing for restaurants and cafes

description.p: Order It Up (OIU) is a commercial, offline-first Point of Sale and billing system built for cafes, restaurants, cloud kitchens, and food businesses. It runs reliably on your local machine with cloud synchronization.

ul.li: Fast order entry with multiple order types (dine-in, takeaway, delivery)
Kitchen Display System (KDS) with real-time updates
Thermal receipt printing via ESC/POS (USB and network)
Indian GST-compliant tax invoicing and sales reports
Works offline — reliable local operations with cloud subscription management

description.p: Initial commercial release of Order It Up: Indian GST engine, offline SQLite core, cloud sync, KDS, tableside ordering, and multi-platform packaging.
